title: Memory IP CAD Engineer
teaser: Join our team as a Memory IP CAD Engineer, contributing to the development of advanced SRAM/TCAM memory solutions. You will write DRC command files, develop verification methodologies, and build automated scripts for physical verification. Ideal candidates have significant experience in IC physical verification and expertise with advanced process nodes.
description:
Who You’ll Work With

Join the Cisco Silicon One team in developing essential building blocks for web-scale and service provider networks. Our SRAM / TCAM design team unites a circuit architect, circuit designer, CAD engineer, and manager, each bringing specialized expertise to create advanced memory solutions. We focus on technical excellence, streamlined processes, and open collaboration to deliver robust SRAM / TCAM designs and meet ambitious project goals. Committed to innovation and teamwork, we tackle complex challenges and drive the future of memory technology together.

What You’ll Do
Command File Development: Write DRC command files for advanced verification. (e.g Redundant Via check/Wide metal via count check....)
Develop methodology and construct flow to verify memory IP layout.
Automation Engineering: Build and maintain automated scripts to streamline the physical verification.
Other flow Development: IR/EM flow development (Totem/Redhawk)

Who You Are
Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
Experience: Minimum of 3+ years of experience in IC Physical Verification.
Process Node: Proven track record with 7nm or below FinFET advanced process nodes.
EDA Tool Mastery: Expert-level proficiency with Siemens Calibre (DRC/LVS/perc), Totem, Redhawk, Synopsys IC Validator
Scripting Languages: Deep knowledge of SVRF, TVF, Tcl, Python, or Shell scripting.
Language Proficiency: Strong technical communication skills in English and Mandarin.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
